correctness.rationale: With H the exceptional-project indicator and Z omitted unit projects, E Z=cq. Strict nonoverbudget outcomes with H=1 require Z>=ceil(c), and the cap requires Z>=ell=max(0,ceil(c-delta)). The resulting lower bound r>=q(ceil(c)-c)/(ceil(c)-ell) is valid for every lottery. When delta<frac(c), E Z>=q ceil(c)>cq makes the constraints infeasible. An explicit mixture of H=0,Z=0 and H=1,Z in {ell,ceil(c)} achieves equality. Uniform cyclic omission subsets make each cheap marginal exactly 1-cq/k; all support outcomes obey BB1 and the cap. The integer-cost case admits exact-budget outcomes. Exact-rational checks on 2940 instances and independent complete-distribution LP comparisons on 420 instances passed; only the proof supports the infinite parameter range.

evidence: Aziz et al. 2024, https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.05198, Theorem 3.2: all feasible fractional PB vectors have some BB1 implementation, but its theorem is existential rather than an exact sharp tail-risk minimization for fixed weighted project marginals.

Wang and Wang 2016, https://doi.org/10.1287/moor.2015.0755, studies joint mixability and fixed marginal sum laws; its accessible abstract concerns different distribution classes and a general coupling framework.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The new proof establishes the optimum among all distributions with the prescribed marginals, and then constructs a BB1 optimizer. Earlier BB1 existence and general coupling techniques do not logically give the exact optimum or its discontinuous dependence on a hard cap. Stronger or differently formulated uncatalogued coupling results remain a risk, especially where full source text was not accessible.

originality.rationale: The primary full-text Sections 2-3 establish general BB1 implementability but not the sharp probability-of-overspending versus allowed-overrun ladder. Searches of relevant indexed mathematical findings, source aliases and alternative Bernoulli-coupling terminology yielded no equivalent explicit risk frontier; general stochastic coupling or dependent rounding results do not directly imply the formula. Publication-priority uncertainty persists for inaccessible full texts, unindexed tables and alternative formulations.
residual_risks: The optimal-coupling and dependent-rounding literatures are broad; abstract-only secondary-source inspection cannot exclude an explicit previously published equivalent formula elsewhere.
The public search and mathematical-result index is not an exhaustive novelty oracle.
The theorem assumes identical unit-project marginals; it is not a general heterogeneous marginal risk formula.

value.rationale: The initiating public-finance lottery result makes BB1 implementation possible without quantifying the chance of violating a hard budget. Risk of overspend and its maximum amount are directly relevant decision criteria. This theorem supplies a complete exact policy frontier, sharp impossibility threshold, harmonic step transitions, equality construction and O(k) support in a canonical one-exceptional-cost model. The dimension and restrictions arise from the natural heterogeneous-cost obstacle, not an arbitrary table cell.
